json_schema.title: file.find
json_schema.description: Approximate the Unix find(1) command and return a list of paths that meet the specified criteria.

path.title: Root path
path.description: The starting directory path on the minion where the search traversal begins.

name.title: Glob pattern
name.description: Case-sensitive glob pattern to match against the file basename.

iname.title: Glob pattern (case-insensitive)
iname.description: Case-insensitive glob pattern to match against the file basename.

regex.title: Regular expression
regex.description: Case-sensitive Python regular expression pattern to match against the file basename.

iregex.title: Regular expression (case-insensitive)
iregex.description: Case-insensitive Python regular expression pattern to match against the file basename.

type.title: Type
type.description: Matches specified file types (e.g., 'a' for all file types, 'b' for block device, 'c' for character device, 'f' for plain file, 'd' for directory), 'p' for FIFO (named pipe), 'l' for symlink, 's' for socket)

owner.title: Owner
owner.description: Comma-separated list of user names or UIDs.

group.title: Group
group.description: Comma-separated list of group names or GIDs.

size.title: Size
size.description: Matches file size using [+-]number[unit] format (e.g., +10m for larger than 10 Megabytes).

mtime.title: Modification time
mtime.description: Matches files modified within the given interval string (e.g., +30d for older than 30 days).

grep.title: Content search
grep.description: Searches for a regular expression pattern inside the file contents. Windows does not support the grep functionality.

delete.title: Delete
delete.description: Deletes the found paths that match the criteria. Can be filtered by file types (e.g., 'a' for all file types, 'b' for block device, 'c' for character device, 'f' for plain file, 'd' for directory), 'p' for FIFO (named pipe), 'l' for symlink, 's' for socket).

exec.title: Execute command
exec.description: Runs a specified shell command, where '{}' is replaced by the current pathname.

print.title: Print
print.description: Outputs specific metadata properties for the matched paths (e.g., group, md5, mode, mtime, name, path, size, type, owner).

maxdepth.title: Maximum depth
maxdepth.description: The maximum number of directory levels to descend into during the search traversal.

mindepth.title: Minimum depth
mindepth.description: The minimum number of directory levels to descend before evaluating matching criteria.
